Account / Admin Officer Job at Excel and Grace Consulting




        
    

        
        Excel and Grace Consulting is a fast-paced business consulting organization with a track record of delivering exceptional business solutions to small and medium-scale enterprises in Nigeria, Ghana, Germany, Switzerland, Canada, etc. We are certified management consultants with the International Council of Management Consulting Institutes (CMC-Global) with over 18 years of experience. Our team of experts and consultants have authored over 20 books on business management, business structure, business operations, human resources, organizational structure, employee development, money management, and so on.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Account / Admin Officer
     

            
    



Job Location: Ebute-meta, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Admin & Accounts Officer to manage the company’s day-to-day administrative activities while providing support with basic accounting and financial records.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage daily administrative and office operations.
	Maintain accurate records, files, invoices, receipts, and financial documents.
	Prepare and track invoices, payments, expenses, and petty cash.
	Assist with bank reconciliations and basic bookkeeping.
	Monitor company expenses and maintain proper documentation.
	Handle correspondence, documentation, and office supplies.
	Support payroll preparation and staff-related administrative records.
	Handle procurement processes ,vendor sourcing, quotations, purchase orders, documentation, and payment follow-up.
	Manage office inventory and maintain updated records of equipment, supplies, and organizational assets.
	Prepare internal communications such as memos, meeting minutes, letters, and official correspondence.
	Support HR tasks including recruitment, interviews, onboarding, staff and documentation
	Maintain accurate staff records including attendance, leave, payroll data, and performance documentation.
	Ensure proper filing and confidentiality of company information.
	Prepare and submit monthly administrative and financial reports.
	Perform other administrative and accounting duties assigned by management.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree / HND qualification in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
	1–3 years of experience in an administrative or accounting role.
	Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office.
	Basic knowledge of accounting principles and bookkeeping.
	Strong organizational and record-keeping skills.
	Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to multitask, meet deadlines, and work with minimal supervision.
	Experience with accounting software is an added advantage.


Salary
N200,000 Monthly.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] and [email protected] using the specific Job Position you are interested in as the subject of the email.

Customer Service / Front Desk Officer Job at Blue Coral Healthcare Services




        
    

        
        Blue Coral Healthcare Services (BCHS) is a diagnostic center with integrated Clinical Services, located at Kengraphics Building, No. 1 Ajiran Road, (Agungi- Bus-stop) Off Lekki-Epe Expressway, Lekki, Lagos State. BCHS is conceived to identify Diagnostics and Clinical needs through innovative diagnostic medical practices which includes Imaging, Pathology, specialty clinics (Eye, Dental, Physiotherapy, Endoscopy and Dialysis), as well as other tailored packages. 

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position:  Customer Service / Front Desk Officer 

Job Location: Agungi Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports to: Medical Doctor
     

            
    



Summary


	The main functions of the post involve the transportation of patients and supplies within the Hospital and any other duties appropriate to the grade, which may be assigned from time to time.


Essential Function of the job


	Deal with customer/staff/patient enquires and questions in a courteous, effective and efficient manner
	Collect & dispose of hospital refuse, clinical waste & laundry in line with Hospital policy.
	Collection and transportation of X-rays, reports, medical records, specimens etc. as required.
	Collection/transportation of supplies/equipment within the Hospital.
	Assist in the lifting, mobilizing, and transportation of patients as per diagnostic centre policy & health and safety guidelines.
	Collection and delivery of Hospital post.
	Changing and movement of medical equipment.
	Carry out cleaning duties in designated areas as required in accordance with infection control and health and safety guidelines.
	Telephone, Reception, & Switchboard duties as required.
	Prepare Laboratory orders & highlight low stock items to office staff.
	Maintain stock levels as required.
	Grounds maintenance duties on Bank Holidays or Weekends as required.
	Be familiar with and comply with Health & Safety policies, procedures and standards.
	Adhere to Hospital infection control policy and be aware of and exercise best practice in relation to personal hygiene.
	Adhere to the prescribed dress code and to wear any personal protective equipment provided including protective clothing and protective footwear.
	Use any safety equipment provided.
	Take all the necessary steps to ensure the maximum security and safety of the working area and all equipment and supplies contained therein.
	Co-operate fully and participate with/in all health and safety training programme
	Be familiar with and comply with lifting & handling techniques
	Be familiar with the Hospital’s Major Emergency Plan, and Fire Plan.


Accountabilties:


	Take direction and guidance from Customer Service officer /Relevant Department Head in relation to duties.
	Report for duty on time and at the designated place of duty as prescribed.
	Perform duties efficiently, effectively and economically in line with best practice and/or as directed by supervisor.
	management in the provision of a quality service at all times and to be flexible in the performance of such
	Strictly adhere to operational policies and procedures specific to designated area of duty.
	Maintain confidentiality of all matters pertaining to the diagnostic centre, staff and patients.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
